name: Becoming An Adult
overview: Becoming an adult, according to Scripture, involves trusting in the LORD wholeheartedly rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 teaches. It is a process rooted in godly training from youth, ensuring that one remains steadfast in the ways of the Lord throughout life, as emphasized in Proverbs 22:6. True maturity also means living justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God, reflecting the heart of Micah 6:8. Above all, embracing the saving love of God through faith in Jesus Christ secures everlasting life and the hope of a purposeful future, as revealed in John 3:16 and Jeremiah 29:11.
